content:
BUILT CoLAB, represented by Marco Pedroso, Head of Sustainability, participated in the Congress organized by the Order of Technical Engineers dedicated to “The Future of Engineering in Portugal – New Challenges and Opportunities”, which took place on September 2, in Porto.

In his intervention in Panel 3 of the event, Marco Pedroso made a presentation entitled “Greenhouse Gases: developments in the AEC sector”. This panel also included the participation of José Cabeçadas (OET) and João Sousa (OET), and was moderated by Cristina Cardoso (OET).

This congress debated four main topics, digital transition, innovation, sustainability and circular economy, with the ultimate goal of identifying the main challenges and opportunities that Technical Engineers, in their various specialties, will face in the current global context.
